0.content:
Jebrael was Jeht's father, an Eremite who left the Tanit and then the Thutmose, where he and Samail were the "Twin Blades of Thutmose"; his old comrades called him the "Treacherous Grit." His wife Ufairah, a researcher, was killed by Samail when they tried to leave the desert. In 3.1 he and Jeht were hired by the researcher Tirzad. At Khaj-Nisut he got Jeht back from Samail by tricking him into speaking the prayer of the Golden Slumber; when Samail seized control of it and tried to drag everyone in, Jebrael entered it himself to fight him so the others could flee. In 6.6, when Aaru opened, his freed spirit met Jeht briefly and told her not to weep.

His last thoughts in 3.1 asked Jeht to forgive him for breaking his promise to stay with her. His final words in 6.6 said she had grown, that she would go further than he ever did, and asked only that she take care of herself.

1.content: Benben is an unusual Primal Construct Jeht found in the ruins at Abdju Pit during Lost in the Sands and named herself. It only beeps, but she says she can read its emotions. It opens sealed doors and mechanisms in King Deshret's ruins, was briefly taken by Samail and the Fatui in 3.1, ran out of power at the Tanit Camps and was recharged with capacitors the Traveler took from the Fatui, and stays with Jeht after the Tanit fall. In 6.6 it worked the mechanism that freed the Traveler in Gurabad.

2.content:
Babel was the matriarch of the Tanit, who called Jeht her most beloved daughter. She removed rival elders, using Jeht as her assassin, and planned to make the Eternal Oasis the seat of her rule as "Prophetess", which meant killing the Traveler to take control of Liloupar. When Jeht refused she offered her to the Fatui for experiments and told Jeht and the Traveler the other had betrayed the tribe. Jeht killed her.

Babel also told the other tribes that Jeht was a traitor, so the wider Eremites may distrust Jeht.

3.content: Liloupar, the Mother of the Jinn from Gurabad, became bound to the Traveler as her master in 3.4. She mocked Jeht at first, calling her "little wildcat", and they came to a prickly understanding. In 6.6 she quelled the Jinn and the sandstorms at Gurabad, and later told Jeht she had grown, no longer flying into a rage at her words.

4.content: Masseira was a Tanit elder and the one name on Jeht's hit list never struck out. He fled the Tanit Camps to a hideout after his daughter Tadhla failed to kill the Traveler, and later crossed the Order of Skeptics. Jeht and her band hunted him, and in 6.6 she told the Traveler she had found his hideout, dragged him from his bed and killed him without listening to his excuses.

5.content: Azariq was Babel's Left Hand, who called Jeht "little wildcat" and claimed they were like family. He guided the Eternal Oasis expedition while secretly working with the Fatui; at the end he demanded the Traveler hand Liloupar over to him, then fought them, and dying, urged Jeht to join him against Babel. Jeht executed him as a traitor to the tribe.

6.content: Ufairah Hindi was Jeht's mother, a researcher hired by the Thutmose to study the secrets of Al-Ahmar, and a relative of the researcher Tirzad. She married Jebrael; Samail killed her when Jebrael tried to leave, believing she had weakened him. Jeht laid her parents' keepsakes at the Eternal Oasis and later took her name as her own.

7.content: Samail, "the Straight Shooter", was Jebrael's old partner in the Thutmose who hunted for Al-Ahmar's power with Fatui help. He killed Ufairah, and in 3.1 held Jeht captive at Khaj-Nisut; Jebrael tricked him into speaking the prayer, and he seized the Golden Slumber from within until Jebrael followed him in.

8.content: Nefer is the Boss of the Curatorium of Secrets in Nod-Krai. She and Jeht exchanged letters and worked together for a long time before meeting at the Temple of Silence in 6.6; Jeht was surprised how young she looked. Jeht approves of her for taking responsibility for her own affairs, "the way of the Desertfolk."

9.content: Dehya is a mercenary of the Blazing Beasts. Jeht recognised her at the Temple of Silence (6.6), surprised to run into her there.

10.content: Jeht wanted to lay her parents' keepsakes in the Eternal Oasis. She did so with the Traveler after finding it, and learned from Liloupar that the goddess who supposedly slept there was long gone. She said that one day, weary of adventuring, she might return to rest beside her parents.

11.comment: Jeht: Dance Dance Dynamic Disco mention
11.content: During the limited-time Dance Dance Dynamic Disco event, Nusta mentions a mercenary with pigtails who fights with twin blades and loves dancing at bonfires. The wiki identifies this as Jeht, but the event does not name her.
